title: Fugaro recipe
description: .fugaro/recipes/<name>.yaml, or fugaro/recipes/<name>.yaml in the runs bucket. See docs/recipes.md. At most 16 KiB; anchors, aliases, tags, repeated keys and extra documents are refused.

name.description: Must equal the file name (repository) or the object name (project).

description.$comment: The pattern refuses C0, DEL, C1 and the BMP format characters and line separators the Go parser refuses (recipe.hasControlChar); the parser is stricter (it also refuses the astral format characters). maxLength here counts Unicode characters (the JSON Schema spec); the Go parser's 200-byte limit (recipe.MaxDescription) is stricter for any multi-byte character, so this schema accepts some strings the parser refuses.

use_when.$comment: maxLength here counts Unicode characters (the JSON Schema spec); the Go parser's 300-byte limit (recipe.MaxUseWhen) is stricter for any multi-byte character, so this schema accepts some strings the parser refuses. The pattern matches the BMP part of the parser's control-character, format-character and line-separator refusal.

reviewer.description: The reviewer role runs on the coder's model and output limit.

coder.description: The coder role runs on the reviewer's (strong) model.

allOf.$comment: outputs: is mode: artifact's own block: a run that opens a pull request delivers its diff, not a file set (recipe.Parse refuses the block in the other two modes, whatever the mode key's value).

A plan or render step is mode: artifact's own shape too: recipe.Parse refuses either in the other two modes with '<kind> is only for mode: artifact' (order), whatever the mode key's value. The steps oneOf above has to list artifactSteps as one alternative for an artifact recipe to have any shape at all, and without this branch that alternative admits [render] under mode: implement — which Go refuses (testdata/recipe/invalid/render-implement.yaml, and its mirror in this schema's own corpus test).

globs.description: The artifact paths to upload, relative to the checkout root. An absolute glob, or one with a .. path element, is refused (recipe.Parse): a recipe may never name a file outside the run's own tree.

max_files.description: How many artifacts the run may upload; absent means 8 (recipe.DefaultOutputFiles).

max_bytes.description: The most ONE artifact may hold; absent means 256 MiB (recipe.DefaultOutputBytes). A written 0 is refused, not read as the default.

max_total_bytes.description: The most the WHOLE SET may hold; absent means 2 GiB (recipe.DefaultOutputTotalBytes). The runner stages a second copy of the set beside the render's originals, so this is what the workflow's resources.memory must hold twice over (docs/design/artifact-runs.md §5.2).

probe.description: Whether commands.probe runs on what was rendered; absent means none.

artifactSteps.description: A mode: artifact recipe's steps: one render, optionally led by one plan (recipe.Parse's orderArtifact).

digest.description: The report run's deterministic first step (recipe.StepDigest): it takes no options, and recipe.Parse refuses it anywhere but first in a mode: implement recipe, at most once, and followed by exactly one review step.

adversarialNoBounce.description: Review level 3's step (recipe.StepAdversarial): at most once, only after the review step, and last. Absent max_rounds means the rigor mode's senior row (rigor.AdversarialDefault): 1 at poc and hotfix, 2 at startup, 3 at pro, 5 at critical. This is the shape for a recipe with no first_line step, where a bounce has nothing to bounce back to.

adversarialBounce.description: The adversarial step beside a firstLine step: bounce is optional (as it is in reviewBounce) and first_line is its only value, so a rejection runs the fix and then another first-line loop. recipe.Parse refuses the bounce when no first_line step precedes the step, which is why the oneOf pairs this def with firstLine.
